title: COVER YOUR HOME
IN PRAYER
end: The Family Altar — cover your home in prayer
stock_queries: warm lamp lit wooden table with open bible and olive branch
peaceful countryside home glowing warmly at twilight
gentle candlelight on a family dinner table evening
serene morning sunlight through a quiet living room window
cozy hearth fire in a quiet traditional family home
tranquil twilight sky over a peaceful rural countryside

scenes.a: Gather your family together right now, pausing to bring your household before the Lord in quiet faith.
Let every distraction fade as we seek His holy presence over our dwelling place this day.
Listen closely to this eternal blessing spoken over your family:
The Lord bless you and keep you; the Lord make his face shine on you and be gracious to you; the Lord turn his face toward you and give you peace.
Father, we rest completely in Your faithful promises, trusting Your gentle guidance for our home.
May His steadfast love surround every room, and may His enduring peace guard every heart until tomorrow. Amen.
